name: gfx_render_enable
doc: NVN's render enable of a queue as the lowering keeps it (src/gfx/report.ts; nxnative nvn_mtl.m g_rc_skip), with the game profile's render_cond. Drawing: draws and clears are lowered. Skipping: a block the game disabled, or whose condition was evaluated false, is being walked: its draws and clears are dropped (compute dispatches, copies and state are not). Enable and Disable are nvnCommandBufferSetRenderEnable(true / false). SetRenderEnableConditional compares the 64-bit counters at an address and 16 bytes after it when the command is lowered: Pass (the condition holds), Fail (it does not), Unknown (one of the counters cannot be known on the CPU: a counter this port does not count, or a record outside memory): an unknown condition draws, because only an evaluated condition is a valid reason to skip. The state is queue state: it lasts across submissions until the next command sets it.
